svg.title: OX-05 First City depth overlap UI artwork board
svg.desc: A schematic board for owner review. It shows a view into the world: outer space and stars form the backdrop, then the Sun and Moon, followed by nearer atmosphere and clouds. The Moon may render in front of the Sun; cloud layers may occupy Background and Middle-Ground and occlude the celestial cues. The moderate-rain panels show full-sky overlapping small-to-medium cloud clusters and one scene-wide rain field with two near-building depth options. This is not installed evidence.
svg.text: OX-05 · First City depth overlap review
UI artwork board · cycle 144 · see cycle plan for approval status and fingerprints · rain-depth options pending · schematic, not installed evidence
VISUAL OBJECTIVE
Keep the First City geometry, selected-time readout, forecast facts, and timeline. Physical overlap follows Background → Middle-Ground → Foreground.
Space and stars → Sun → Moon → nearer atmosphere and clouds; clouds may occlude both celestial cues.
01 · SUN + MOON / OWNER-DIRECTED DEPTH
Outer space and stars form the backdrop; Sun → Moon, then nearer atmosphere and clouds.
MOON · OWNER-DIRECTED DEPTH

svg.text: TIME_CUE (Sun) → LUNAR_CUE (Moon).
The Moon may overlap the Sun; nearer cloud, city, lights, and precipitation layers can cover both.
Cue position, size, phase, and artwork remain unchanged.
02 · RAIN FIELD / NEAR BUILDINGS
Moderate rain: overlapping small-to-medium cloud clusters span both panels; compare near-building depth.

B · FOREGROUND FIELD
Overlapping small-to-medium clouds span Background and Middle-Ground.
A scene-wide moderate-rain field begins below the cloud cover in both options.
Visible-cloud rain starts below cloud base; carried rain without visible clouds keeps its existing field origin.

UNCHANGED AROUND THESE OVERLAPS
• OX-03 shared scene decisions, selected instant, cloud placement bound, and cloud-origin rain rule.
• OX-04 evidence support, unavailable-state treatment, probability meaning, and source-time disclosure.
• First City geometry, cue artwork, forecast foreground, and timeline layout. No new controls or scene theme.
OWNER REVIEW: review the world-layer order and overlapping cloud forms; select A or B for precipitation depth, or request a bounded revision.
These vector panels are schematic targets. Cycle 144 still needs installed screenshots and scoped visual checks for acceptance.
